title: Carolina Collection 30-Inch Wall Mount Towel Bar In Solid Brass | Allied Brass
body_html:
Stop piling towels on the vanity and give your bathroom a dedicated, easy-to-reach place to hang them. This Carolina Collection towel bar brings traditional, timeless styling to classic bath accessories while keeping your space organized.

  • Keep towels tidy and accessible with a 30-Inch wall mount towel bar that creates a defined spot for daily towels.
  • Coordinate a cohesive bath with the Carolina Collection—ideal for matching Carolina pieces and traditional bathroom hardware.
  • Maintain a clean, finished look thanks to concealed mounting hardware.
  • Save space in the bathroom with a wall-mounted design that keeps towels off counters and shelves.

  • Weight: 3.2 lbs
  • Material: solid brass
